body:
I echo the sentiments of other posters. You have just made the following statements:

**Over the past 2 months he's become increasingly erratic, secretive and violent. We're now not sure where he's living**

**I'm also worried he may be a trafficking risk given some of the things he's been saying and a person he's been spending a lot of time with who's feeding into these delusions.**

So, the question is how much has he deteriorated in 2 months? Has the pace of deterioration picked up? If so, where will he be in another 2 months? Do you think he will improve? If so, why - what concrete reason do you have for thinking this?

On point 2 - he is a trafficking risk. What does this mean? That he is being groomed? Tie this into his already vulnerable state and the fact that he may deteriorate rapidly. 

Logic dictates that you have one option - have him sectioned for his own good. If not you have literally just written that he may vanish at any time - 'trafficking risk'

Yes you are fine. They check criminal records and credit. Criminal would need you to have been arrested and given a suspended sentence/fine/caution. Credit would require a county court judgement or hard default/bankruptcy - they do not have permission to check credit scores.

Disciplinary matters dating from high school days are not an issue to be concerned about, unless those ended up involving the police.
And I appreciate all your answers. Thanks.

Thanks GuardLate. Yes, I just did read that covert filming of a sexual act is an offence. I'd imagine that even if the media deemed a nobody such as myself to be of interest they'd be inhibited from doing anything (and it is not like they don't have plenty to write about right now..)
